keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Arouca 0, CD Nacional 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Francisco Gonçalves (CD Nacional).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Arouca. Pablo Gozálbez replaces Taichi Fukui.
Goal! Arouca 1, CD Nacional 0. Tiago Esgaio (Arouca) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Naïs Djouahra with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Matchoi Djaló replaces Stavros Gavriel.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Danel Dongmo replaces Chiheb Laabidi.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Pablo Ruan replaces Abdel Njoya.
Substitution, Arouca. Dylan Nandín replaces Barbero.
Matchoi Djaló (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Arouca. Lee Hyun-Ju replaces Mateo Flores.
Substitution, Arouca. Brian Mansilla replaces Alfonso Trezza.
Orest Lebedenko (Arouca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Danel Dongmo (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Daniel Júnior replaces Miguel Baeza.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Allen Obando replaces Song Min-Kyu.
Pablo Gozálbez (Arouca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
